interpretation.plain_speak: Four unfinished dependencies fit. Five causes exactly one memory miss in every tested condition, and six causes exactly two. The memory boundary is clean. But 25 of 200 five-dependency language cells still guessed the missing report correctly, mostly in the fourth lexical family, so output accuracy can sometimes hide a real memory failure.
interpretation.north_star_question: Separates sequence-capacity failure from language fallback: fixed-capacity dependency closure is now pinned exactly, but we must determine whether apparent success after a memory miss is genuine generalization or a learned/default guess.
interpretation.next_stage: at D=5, remap held report values with frozen deterministic permutations while preserving the same memory pressure, then test whether the parametric fallback tracks the remapped dependency or collapses
